<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Boda de Gabriela de los Ángeles &amp; Jorge Luis</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;600&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.469.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.6.0/dist/confetti.browser.min.js"></script>
<script>
tailwind.config={theme:{extend:{colors:{bt:{700:'#385444',800:'#2c4336',900:'#1b2e24'},gold:{300:'#f0e2b6',400:'#dfc476',500:'#d4af37',700:'#8c6b16'},cream:{200:'#f8f4ec'}},fontFamily:{serif:['Cormorant Garamond','serif'],playfair:['Playfair Display','serif'],sans:['Montserrat','sans-serif']}}}}
</script>
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
body{background:#f8f4ec;margin:0}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#385444 0%,#1b2e24 70%)}
.card{background:rgba(253,251,247,.95);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.35)}
.names{background:rgba(27,46,36,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
@keyframes hb{0%,28%,70%,100%{transform:scale(1)}14%,42%{transform:scale(1.18)}}
.hb{animation:hb 1.8s infinite ease-in-out}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.gold{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b89228,#f0e2b6,#d4af37,#f0e2b6,#b89228);background-size:200% auto;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:sh 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes sh{to{background-position:200% center}}
.petal{position:absolute;top:-20px;width:10px;height:14px;border-radius:70% 0 70% 0;background:#d4af37;opacity:.35;animation:fall linear infinite}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(540deg)}}
.opt{border:1px solid #d6d3d1;background:#fff;transition:all .25s}
.opt.on{background:#1b2e24;color:#f0e2b6;border-color:#d4af37}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
nav button{transition:background .3s,color .3s}
nav button.nact{background:#d4af37;color:#1b2e24;font-weight:600}
@keyframes fl{50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
.fl{animation:fl 4s ease-in-out infinite}
html,body{overflow:hidden;height:100%}
#book{position:fixed;inset:0;perspective:1800px;background:#2a1f14}
.pg{--sp:inset 12px 0 18px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset -3px 0 0 #e8dcc0;will-change:transform,opacity;position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:#f8f4ec;transform-origin:left center;box-shadow:var(--sp)}
@keyframes tn{0%{transform:rotateY(0) skewY(0);opacity:1;box-shadow:var(--sp)}25%{transform:rotateY(-35deg) skewY(.8deg);box-shadow:var(--sp),8px 0 26px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}55%{transform:rotateY(-80deg) skewY(-.5deg);opacity:1;box-shadow:var(--sp),6px 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}80%{transform:rotateY(-98deg) skewY(0);opacity:.85;box-shadow:var(--sp)}100%{transform:rotateY(-105deg);opacity:0;box-shadow:var(--sp)}}
.pg.turned{transform:rotateY(-105deg);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;animation:tn 1.3s ease-in-out both}
.pg.ret{animation:tn 1.3s ease-in-out both reverse}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pg.turned,.pg.ret{animation-duration:.01s}}
.pg>section{padding-bottom:6rem;min-height:auto}
.pg>section:not(.hero){padding-top:4.5rem}
.pg>section.hero,.pg>#lugar{min-height:100%}
#lugar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
#lugar>*{width:100%}
.pg footer{padding-bottom:6rem}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fl{animation:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rv{transition:none;opacity:1;transform:none}.petal,.gold,.hb{animation:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body class="font-sans text-bt-900 overflow-x-hidden">

<div id="entry" class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center hero text-white p-6 transition-opacity duration-1000">
  <div class="text-center max-w-sm space-y-6">
    <p class="uppercase tracking-[0.35em] text-xs text-gold-400">Nuestra Boda</p>
    <h1 class="font-playfair text-3xl font-light">Gabriela &amp; Jorge Luis</h1>
    <p class="font-serif italic text-gold-300 text-sm">Toca el corazón dorado para abrir la invitación</p>
    <button onclick="enter()" aria-label="Abrir invitación" class="hb my-4 inline-flex p-6 rounded-full bg-bt-800 border-2 border-gold-400/80 shadow-2xl">
      <i data-lucide="heart" class="w-14 h-14 text-gold-400 fill-gold-400/50"></i>
    </button>
    <p class="text-stone-400 text-xs tracking-wider uppercase">13 de Diciembre de 2026</p>
  </div>
</div>

<button id="mt" onclick="toggleMusic()" aria-label="Música" class="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-bt-900 text-gold-400 border-2 border-gold-400/60 shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center">
  <i id="mi" data-lucide="music" class="w-6 h-6"></i>
</button>

<main id="main" class="opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-1000">
  <nav class="fixed left-0 right-0 z-30 flex justify-center gap-1 sm:gap-4 px-2 py-2 bg-bt-900/85 backdrop-blur border-b border-gold-400/20 text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-gold-300" style="top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)">
    <button onclick="go('inicio')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gold-400/20">Inicio</button>
    <button onclick="go('historia')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gold-400/20">Historia</button>
    <button onclick="go('lugar')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gold-400/20">Lugar</button>
    <button onclick="go('rsvp')" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gold-400/20">Confirmar</button>
  </nav>
  <section id="inicio" class="hero relative overflow-hidden min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center gap-6 items-center text-center px-4 pt-20 pb-8 text-white"><div id="petals" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none"></div>
    <div class="text-center"><svg class="fl w-32 h-[4.3rem] mx-auto" viewBox="0 0 120 64" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="rg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0e2b6"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#d4af37"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b89228"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M63 20.95A22 22 0 1 1 57.15 25.86" stroke="url(#rg)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M53.52 60.67A22 22 0 1 1 65.05 51" stroke="url(#rg)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M74 3l6.5 7.5L74 18l-6.5-7.5z" fill="#f0e2b6" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg><h2 class="uppercase tracking-[0.35em] text-xs text-gold-400 pt-2">Nuestra Boda</h2></div>
    <div class="names my-6 py-10 px-6 sm:px-14 rounded-3xl border border-gold-400/40 shadow-2xl max-w-3xl">
      <h1 class="font-playfair text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-light">Gabriela de los Ángeles</h1>
      <p class="font-serif text-xl sm:text-2xl text-gold-300 italic">Medrano Solís</p>
      <div class="font-serif italic text-5xl gold my-2">&amp;</div>
      <h1 class="font-playfair text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-light">Jorge Luis</h1>
      <p class="font-serif text-xl sm:text-2xl text-gold-300 italic">Oviedo Torres</p>
      <div class="w-32 h-px bg-gold-400 mx-auto my-6"></div>
      <div class="space-y-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-widest text-stone-200">
        <p class="uppercase text-gold-300">Domingo, 13 de Diciembre de 2026</p>
        <p>5:30 PM</p>
        <p>Hotel Casa Natura · Chichigalpa, Nicaragua</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="max-w-xl w-full">
      <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-gold-400 mb-3">Cuenta Regresiva para el Gran Día</p>
      <div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 sm:gap-4">
        <div class="bg-bt-800/80 border border-gold-500/40 rounded-xl p-3"><span id="d" class="font-serif text-3xl text-gold-300 block">00</span><span class="text-[10px] uppercase text-stone-400">Días</span></div>
        <div class="bg-bt-800/80 border border-gold-500/40 rounded-xl p-3"><span id="h" class="font-serif text-3xl text-gold-300 block">00</span><span class="text-[10px] uppercase text-stone-400">Horas</span></div>
        <div class="bg-bt-800/80 border border-gold-500/40 rounded-xl p-3"><span id="m" class="font-serif text-3xl text-gold-300 block">00</span><span class="text-[10px] uppercase text-stone-400">Min</span></div>
        <div class="bg-bt-800/80 border border-gold-500/40 rounded-xl p-3"><span id="s" class="font-serif text-3xl text-gold-300 block">00</span><span class="text-[10px] uppercase text-stone-400">Seg</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button onclick="go('historia')" class="animate-bounce text-gold-400 pt-2" aria-label="Bajar"><i data-lucide="chevron-down" class="w-8 h-8"></i></button>
  </section>

  <section id="historia" class="py-8 px-6 max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center">
    <div class="card rv rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl space-y-3">
      <p class="uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-xs text-gold-700 font-semibold">Nuestra Historia</p>
      <h2 class="font-playfair text-3xl sm:text-4xl">Con la Bendición de Dios</h2>
      <div class="w-16 h-px bg-gold-500 mx-auto"></div>
      <p class="font-serif text-xl text-stone-700 italic">“El amor es paciente, es servicial. El amor todo lo disculpa, todo lo cree, todo lo espera, todo lo soporta.”</p>
      <p class="text-stone-600 text-sm leading-relaxed font-light">Tenemos el gran honor de invitarte a celebrar el día en que unimos nuestras vidas. Tu presencia hará que este momento sea aún más especial e inolvidable para nosotros.</p>
      <div class="bg-cream-200 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gold-400/40 space-y-3">
        <div><span class="block text-xs uppercase text-stone-500 font-semibold">Fecha &amp; Hora</span><span class="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">13 de Diciembre, 2026 · 5:30 PM</span></div>
        <div><span class="block text-xs uppercase text-stone-500 font-semibold">Lugar</span><span class="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">Hotel Casa Natura, Chichigalpa</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 font-serif italic text-xl text-bt-800">
        <span>Gabriela</span><i data-lucide="heart" class="w-4 h-4 fill-gold-500 text-gold-500"></i><span>Jorge Luis</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="lugar" class="py-10 px-6 bg-bt-900 text-white text-center">
    <p class="uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-xs text-gold-400 font-semibold mb-2">Ubicación de la Recepción</p>
    <h2 class="font-playfair text-3xl sm:text-5xl mb-4">Lugar del Evento</h2>
    <figure class="rv relative max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-5 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-gold-400/40"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hotel Casa Natura, Chichigalpa" class="w-full h-72 sm:h-96 object-cover"><div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-bt-900/80 via-transparent to-transparent"></div><figcaption class="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4 text-center font-serif italic text-gold-300 text-lg sm:text-xl">Hotel Casa Natura, Chichigalpa</figcaption></figure>
    <div class="rv max-w-md mx-auto bg-bt-800/90 border border-gold-400/30 rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-4 text-left">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-gold-400"><i data-lucide="map-pin" class="w-6 h-6"></i><h3 class="font-playfair text-2xl text-white">Chichigalpa</h3></div>
      <p class="text-stone-300 text-sm leading-relaxed font-light">La celebración se llevará a cabo en el <strong class="text-gold-300">Hotel Casa Natura</strong>, un espacio colonial y cálido preparado especialmente para recibir a nuestros seres queridos.</p>
      <p class="text-xs text-stone-300"><strong class="text-gold-300">Dirección:</strong> Chichigalpa, Nicaragua</p>
      <p class="text-xs text-stone-300"><strong class="text-gold-300">Hora de Inicio:</strong> 5:30 PM</p>
      <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&amp;query=Hotel%20Casa%20Natura%20Chichigalpa%20Nicaragua" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="w-full mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gold-400/20 border border-gold-400/50 text-gold-300 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest"><i data-lucide="navigation" class="w-4 h-4"></i>Abrir en Google Maps</a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="rsvp" class="py-8 px-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
    <div class="card rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl rv">
      <div class="text-center mb-5">
        <p class="uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-xs text-gold-700 font-semibold mb-2">RSVP</p>
        <h2 class="font-playfair text-3xl sm:text-4xl">Confirma tu Asistencia</h2>
        <p class="text-stone-600 text-sm font-light mt-4">Confírmanos por WhatsApp con tu nombre y una dedicatoria.</p>
      </div>
      <form onsubmit="rsvp(event)" class="space-y-4">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <button type="button" id="a-si" onclick="setAtt('si')" class="opt on rounded-xl py-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">Sí, asistiré</button>
          <button type="button" id="a-no" onclick="setAtt('no')" class="opt rounded-xl py-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">No podré asistir</button>
        </div>
        <div id="gbox" class="hidden items-center justify-between bg-cream-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 border border-gold-400/40">
          <span class="text-xs uppercase font-semibold">Número de personas</span>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
            <button type="button" onclick="gst(-1)" class="opt w-9 h-9 rounded-full text-lg" aria-label="Menos">−</button>
            <span id="gc" class="font-serif text-2xl w-6 text-center">1</span>
            <button type="button" onclick="gst(1)" class="opt w-9 h-9 rounded-full text-lg" aria-label="Más">+</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div><label for="gn" class="block text-xs uppercase font-semibold mb-2">Nombre Completo *</label>
          <input id="gn" required placeholder="Ej. Ana María Gutiérrez" class="w-full px-4 py-3.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 bg-white text-stone-800 text-sm"></div>
        <div><label for="sn" class="block text-xs uppercase font-semibold mb-2">Mensaje o Dedicatoria (Opcional)</label>
          <textarea id="sn" rows="3" placeholder="Escribe unas palabras para Gabriela y Jorge Luis..." class="w-full px-4 py-3.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 bg-white text-stone-800 text-sm"></textarea></div>
        <a id="wab" href="https://wa.me/50583619635" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="return wsend()" class="cursor-pointer w-full bg-bt-900 text-gold-300 py-4 rounded-xl shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-3 border border-gold-400/30 uppercase text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider">
          <i data-lucide="message-circle" class="w-5 h-5"></i>Confirmar por WhatsApp</a>
      </form>
      <div id="ok" class="hidden text-center mt-6 space-y-3"><p class="font-serif italic text-bt-800 text-lg">¡Gracias! Te esperamos con mucho cariño.</p><a id="wa" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-bt-900 text-gold-300 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold">Toca aquí si WhatsApp no se abrió</a></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer class="py-8 bg-bt-900 text-stone-400 text-center text-xs tracking-widest uppercase">
    <p class="font-serif text-xl text-gold-400 italic mb-2 normal-case">Gabriela de los Ángeles &amp; Jorge Luis</p>
    <p>13 de Diciembre de 2026 · Hotel Casa Natura, Chichigalpa</p>
    <p class="mt-6 text-[10px] text-stone-500">¡Agradecemos tu amor y compañía en este día tan especial!</p>
  </footer>
</main>

<audio id="bgm" loop preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
<script>
lucide.createIcons();
var playing=false,ctx=null,iv=null;
function synth(){var a=document.getElementById('bgm');a.volume=.8;var r=a.play();if(r&&r.catch)r.catch(function(){})}
function icon(){
  document.getElementById('mi').setAttribute('data-lucide',playing?'pause':'music');
  lucide.createIcons();
}
function toggleMusic(){
  if(playing){document.getElementById('bgm').pause();playing=false}
  else{playing=true;synth()}
  icon();
}
function enter(){
  if(typeof confetti==='function')confetti({particleCount:85,spread:100,origin:{y:.6},colors:['#d4af37','#dfc476','#385444','#fdfbf7']});
  var e=document.getElementById('entry');
  e.classList.add('opacity-0','pointer-events-none');
  setTimeout(function(){e.style.display='none';document.getElementById('main').classList.remove('opacity-0')},900);
  playing=true;synth();icon();
}
var target=new Date('December 13, 2026 17:30:00').getTime();
function tick(){
  var d=Math.max(0,target-Date.now()),p=function(v){return String(v).padStart(2,'0')};
  document.getElementById('d').innerText=p(Math.floor(d/864e5));
  document.getElementById('h').innerText=p(Math.floor(d%864e5/36e5));
  document.getElementById('m').innerText=p(Math.floor(d%36e5/6e4));
  document.getElementById('s').innerText=p(Math.floor(d%6e4/1e3));
}
setInterval(tick,1000);tick();
var ids=['inicio','historia','lugar','rsvp'];
function spy(){
  var bs=document.querySelectorAll('nav button'),y=window.innerHeight*.35,cur=0;
  ids.forEach(function(id,i){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(el&&el.getBoundingClientRect().top<=y)cur=i});
  if((window.innerHeight+(window.pageYOffset||document.documentElement.scrollTop))>=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-4)cur=ids.length-1;
  bs.forEach(function(b,i){b.classList.toggle('nact',i===cur)});
}
window.addEventListener('scroll',spy,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',spy);spy();
function go(id){var el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;var y=el.getBoundingClientRect().top+(window.pageYOffset||document.documentElement.scrollTop)-(id==='inicio'?0:52);try{window.scrollTo({top:y,behavior:'smooth'})}catch(x){window.scrollTo(0,y)}}
function cal(){window.open('https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text='+encodeURIComponent('Boda de Gabriela y Jorge Luis')+'&dates=20261213T233000Z/20261214T033000Z&location='+encodeURIComponent('Hotel Casa Natura, Chichigalpa, Nicaragua')+'&details='+encodeURIComponent('Te esperamos para celebrar nuestra boda.'),'_blank')}
function maps(){window.open('https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent('Hotel Casa Natura Chichigalpa Nicaragua'),'_blank')}
(function(){
  var p=document.getElementById('petals');
  for(var i=0;i<16;i++){var x=document.createElement('span');x.className='petal';x.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';x.style.animationDuration=(9+Math.random()*8)+'s';x.style.animationDelay=(-Math.random()*14)+'s';x.style.transform='scale('+(.6+Math.random()*.9)+')';p.appendChild(x)}
  var els=document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){var o=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){en.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');o.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.15});els.forEach(function(el){o.observe(el)})}
  else{els.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')})}
})();
var att='si',gn=1;
function setAtt(v){att=v;document.getElementById('a-si').classList.toggle('on',v==='si');document.getElementById('a-no').classList.toggle('on',v==='no')}
function gst(d){gn=Math.min(10,Math.max(1,gn+d));document.getElementById('gc').innerText=gn}
function rsvp(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var n=document.getElementById('gn').value.trim(),s=document.getElementById('sn').value.trim();
  var t='¡Hola! '+(att==='si'?'Confirmo mi asistencia':'Lamento no poder asistir')+' a la boda de Gabriela y Jorge Luis.\n\n*Nombre:* '+n;
  
  if(s)t+='\n*Mensaje / Dedicatoria:* '+s;
  var u='https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=50583619635&text='+encodeURIComponent(t);
  document.getElementById('wa').href=u;
  try{window.open(u,'_blank')}catch(x){}
  document.getElementById('ok').classList.remove('hidden');
  if(att==='si'&&typeof confetti==='function')confetti({particleCount:70,spread:80,origin:{y:.8},colors:['#d4af37','#dfc476','#385444']});
}
function wsend(){
  var n=document.getElementById('gn').value.trim(),s=document.getElementById('sn').value.trim();
  if(!n){var g=document.getElementById('gn');g.focus();g.style.borderColor='#d4af37';g.placeholder='Escribe tu nombre para continuar';return false}
  var si=att==='si';
  var t='¡Hola Gabriela y Jorge Luis! '+String.fromCodePoint(0x1F33F,0x2728)+'\n\nSoy *'+n+'* '+(si?'y confirmo con mucha alegría mi asistencia':'y lamento no poder acompañarlos')+' a su boda el 13 de diciembre de 2026 en el Hotel Casa Natura.';
  if(s)t+='\n\n*Mensaje:* "'+s+'"';
  t+='\n\n¡Felicidades y un fuerte abrazo! '+String.fromCodePoint(0x1F942,0x1F492);
  var u='https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=50583619635&text='+encodeURIComponent(t);
  document.getElementById('wab').href=u;document.getElementById('wa').href=u;
  document.getElementById('ok').classList.remove('hidden');
  if(att==='si'&&typeof confetti==='function')confetti({particleCount:70,spread:80,origin:{y:.8},colors:['#d4af37','#dfc476','#385444']});
  return true;
}
function rsvpOld(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  var n=document.getElementById('gn').value.trim(),s=document.getElementById('sn').value.trim();
  var t='¡Hola! Confirmo mi asistencia a la boda de Gabriela y Jorge Luis.\n\n*Nombre:* '+n;
  if(s)t+='\n*Mensaje / Dedicatoria:* '+s;
  window.open('https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text='+encodeURIComponent(t),'_blank');
}
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var ids=['inicio','historia','lugar','rsvp'],pg=[],cur=0,busy=false,m=document.getElementById('main'),ft=m.querySelector('footer');
  var S='inset 12px 0 18px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset -3px 0 0 #e8dcc0';
  var bk=document.createElement('div');bk.id='book';
  ids.forEach(function(id){var p=document.createElement('div');p.className='pg';p.appendChild(document.getElementById(id));bk.appendChild(p);pg.push(p)});
  pg[3].appendChild(ft);m.appendChild(bk);
  var c=document.createElement('div');
  c.className='fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 flex items-center gap-6 bg-bt-900/90 border border-gold-400/40 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-gold-300 text-xs';
  c.style.bottom='calc(1.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))';
  c.innerHTML='<button id="pv" aria-label="Página anterior" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full text-2xl leading-none">‹</button><button id="nx" aria-label="Página siguiente" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full text-2xl leading-none">›</button>';
  m.appendChild(c);
  function ui(i){
    document.querySelectorAll('nav button').forEach(function(b,k){b.classList.toggle('nact',k===i)});
    document.getElementById('pv').style.opacity=i===0?.3:1;
    document.getElementById('nx').style.opacity=i===pg.length-1?.3:1;
  }
  function apply(i){
    cur=i;window._shown=1;
    pg.forEach(function(p,k){p.style.display=k===cur?'':'none';p.style.zIndex='';p.style.boxShadow=''});
    pg[cur].scrollTop=0;ui(i);
  }
  var KF=[
    {transform:'rotateY(0deg) skewY(0deg)',opacity:1,offset:0},
    {transform:'rotateY(-35deg) skewY(.8deg)',opacity:1,offset:.25},
    {transform:'rotateY(-80deg) skewY(-.5deg)',opacity:1,offset:.55},
    {transform:'rotateY(-98deg) skewY(0deg)',opacity:.85,offset:.8},
    {transform:'rotateY(-105deg) skewY(0deg)',opacity:0,offset:1}
  ];
  function show(i){
    i=Math.max(0,Math.min(pg.length-1,i));
    if(!window._shown||(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)){apply(i);return}
    if(i===cur||busy)return;
    busy=true;
    var fw=i>cur,o=pg[cur],n=pg[i],f=fw?o:n,u=fw?n:o;
    n.scrollTop=0;n.style.display='';
    f.style.zIndex=2;u.style.zIndex=1;
    f.style.boxShadow=S+',10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18)';
    ui(i);
    var a=f.animate(KF,{duration:1300,easing:'ease-in-out',fill:'both',direction:fw?'normal':'reverse'});
    a.onfinish=function(){apply(i);a.cancel();busy=false};
  }
  window.go=function(id){show(ids.indexOf(id))};
  window.spy=function(){};
  document.getElementById('pv').onclick=function(){show(cur-1)};
  document.getElementById('nx').onclick=function(){show(cur+1)};
  var sx=0,sy=0;
  bk.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){sx=e.touches[0].clientX;sy=e.touches[0].clientY},{passive:true});
  bk.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-sx,dy=e.changedTouches[0].clientY-sy;if(Math.abs(dx)>70&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.5)show(cur+(dx<0?1:-1))},{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT'||e.target.tagName==='TEXTAREA')return;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')show(cur+1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')show(cur-1)});
  show(0);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
